name: theme-skeuo
title: Skeuo theme
description: Skeuomorphic theme scoped to [data-theme="skeuo"], tuned by --mat-* material tokens.
docs: Each theme needs two steps: @import its CSS from the CSS file that has @import "tailwindcss" (the path is where the file was installed), and set data-theme="skeuo" on an ancestor, e.g. <html>.
